Name: Fern - a Farmer 2.0 ESFW preset with Weather Wonders functionality
Author: Dexnis
Description:
Fern is a masc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226?tab=description]Farmer 2.0 ESFW[/url] preset that offers an already complete character with portraits for the different weathers, seasons, festivals, and emotions with matching outfit functionality. Fern can also serve as a patch for SVE and Weather Wonders for your own farmer that fixes some minor bugs found in the original content pack. Simply install these files and use the file structure included to replace Fern’s portraits with your own. Then replace the outfits with your own matching designs.




[b]*As a character preset, Fern has matching portraits and Fashion Sense outfits. The portraits and clothing are designed to feel as dynamic and realistic as possible with the following features:[/b]

[list]
[*]All vanilla festivals are available and five Spirit’s Eve variants are included.[/*]
[*]The mining outfit includes a backpack that visibly gets fuller the more you have in your inventory thanks to PeacefulEnd’s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10211?tab=description]Backpacks and Baubles[/url].[/*]
[*]Winter scarves are animated thanks to PeacefulEnd’s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10102]Cozy Scarves[/url].[/*]
[*]Dry hair is animated thanks to Shardust’s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10294]Animated Hairstyles[/url].[/*]
[*]All the portraits have transparent backgrounds and so they will work with portrait background mods.[/*]
[*]In bad weather Fern takes his hat off indoors.[/*]
[*]In the rain Fern’s hair gets damp.[/*]
[*]In the summer he gets a bit of a tan and has a warmer color palette.[/*]
[/list]Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url] and [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/]Jazzybee[/url] for the art and programming in the character creator (found [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]here[/url]) which I used to create the portraits.


[b]*If used for a file structure set up, the following things have been completed for you:[/b]

[list]
[*]All Farmer reactions have now been programmed as of 1.1.0. This is for Vanilla and SVE. Details below.[/*]
[*]Fixed a minor spelling bug in the pajamas.json that caused the morning pajama portraits to not show up.[/*]
[*]Fixed the file structure for weather wonders so that weather wonder outfits and portraits work now.[/*]
[*]I have added support for the Acid Rain, Mist, and Cloudy Weather types from Weather Wonders.[/*]
[*]Fixed SVE’s community day portrait file name so it actually shows up now.[/*]
[/list]

[b]How to install: [/b]
[list]
[*]Download all prerequisite Mods (Most are only needed if using the Fern Character, Ignore the ones denoted as such if you are just taking the file structure to build your own farmer)[/*]
[*]Your Farmer should choose skin number 24 during the character creation.
[spoiler](Most of the outfits override the chosen skin tone to have variation for the summer tan and winter pale, but the shirtless functionality for beach/swimsuit uses the color you choose in the character creation. Choose skin 24 if you want his skin to match the most seamlessly throughout the different outfits. Ideally choose a dark green color for the eyes as well[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the main file into your mods folder[/*]
[*]Let it overwrite[/*]

[*]Duplicate this file and rename it to YOUR farmers name.[/*]
[*]Download the Spirit’s Eve Portraits, pick the costume you want, and replace the images inside of Farmer 2.0 ESWF\assets\farmername\Festivals\Spirit's Eve with the ones you want. Wizard is the default.[/*]
[*]Download the outfits text file and open the file with notepad or whatever text editing software you want to view the text inside of it.[/*]
[*]Start your game, boot up the save file you want these outfits to appear.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Use the fashion sense hand mirror/menu and copy and paste the outfits from the text file into your fashion sense outfits one by one.

[*]The Spirit’s Eve options are at the bottom. Copy and paste ONLY the one you chose.[/*]
[*]Take your character’s non-fashion sense, vanilla, shirt OFF if you want your character to be shirtless when wearing the swimsuit outfit to match the swimsuit portrait. (if you don’t the shirt they are wearing in the vanilla menu will appear when they are supposed to be shirtless)[/*]

[*]You MUST END THE DAY and SAVE in order for these outfits to be added to the file permanently.[/*]

[b]More About the Farmer Reactions:  
[/b]
[list]
[*]ALL vanilla and SVE characters have been combed through to carefully match the correct expressions. The hard work has been done for you! –NO MORE WEIRD EXPRESSIONS!![/*]
[*]The following missing Vanilla and SVE characters have been added to the Unique Reactions settings: [b]Bear, Birdie, Camilla, Dusty, Fizz, Governor, Jolyne, Junimos[/b] (long story short, made it so that the farmer won’t display random emotions depending on what color Junimo pops up),[b] Lance, Magnus, Martin, Mermaid, and Morris[/b]. Not every character needed edits to the reaction portraits but they have been added so you can work with them if you want. [/*]
[*]Leo’s settings are fixed (his name in the portraits files is actually ‘ParrotBoy’ funnily enough) so you can now program unique reactions for him if you want.[/*]
[/list]Why this was needed: Some Vanilla Characters have different emotions in different places in their portrait sheet meaning that sometimes the ‘wrong’ emotion gets called by the Mod (Sam is an example of this, he has a ‘happy’ face that is in the place that is typically an angry face for other characters. Without correcting this, Sam will sometimes trigger the farmer's angry face when he just has a happy expression). There are MANY villagers like this. I have painstakingly gone through and matched the correct farmer response for these characters. There is a limit to this, anything beyond position ‘4’ in the portrait tile sheet will just show a normal face from your farmer so not every extreme emotion from the characters will trigger a response face. This is a limitation built into the original farmer portraits mod. [b]Small farmer character decisions had to be taken when reactions were chosen. Here are some examples of what these choices look like[/b]:

[list]
[*]The farmer reacts to Clint’s blush/embarrassed expression with a straight normal face instead of blushing back.[/*]
[*]The farmer responds with sadness/sympathy in response to anger from children and animals instead of also getting angry.[/*]
[*]The farmer reacts with
[spoiler] sadness/sympathy to Kent’s ‘angry’ face as it is mainly used in the PTSD cutscene.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]The farmer reacts with
[spoiler] sadness/sympathy to the governor's puking-sick face.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]The farmer reacts with
[spoiler] sadness to Qi being disappointed in them.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]All reactions to
[spoiler] Fizz are the blank/normal expression.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list]You can change these responses at any time by editing the ‘specific reactions’ file. I did my best to keep generally accurate to how the farmer would realistically react.
